Issues that should be fixed (Please let us know if not):
"Everytime I assign someone as Wheatmiller, their Health changes to 1/1. Must be some kind of bug..."
"So, why wheatmillers appear to die is that they are reduced to 1 hp. Guessing the same for tattoo artists and barbers."
"sticks are STILL being produced too fast - I have 4.1k of sticks after 6 days"


Probably misunderstood:
"something is wsrong with storage - one barn says it is full, yet only contains 2k of clay - barn should hold 20k?"

notes.title: Content Patch 1
notes.notes:
Hey everybody,

the next update i finally here! Last month were pretty difficult, but we are happy we can finally can give you new and better content. We know there are some bugs that appeared while developing the new content. We fixed a lot of them but will fix more in the coming days, so be aware of that.

In our opinion the game got much better. Tell us what you think!


[h1]Here are some changes:[/h1]

[b]New resources:[/b]
[list]
[*] clay
[*] coal
[*] copper ore
[*] copper bar
[*] tin ore
[*] bronze bar
[*] iron ore
[*] iron bar
[*] steel bar
[*] silver ore
[*] silver bar
[*] gold ore
[*] gold bar
[*] salt
[*] fur 
[*] sticks
[*] animal food
[*] hay
[*] soil
[*] wheat
[*] flour
[*] prezl
[*] simple boots
[*] iron copper neckless 
[*] steel tools
[/list]


[b]New tiles/blocks:[/b]
[list]
[*] small & big clay
[*] small & big coal
[*] small & big copper ore
[*] small & big tin ore
[*] small & big iron ore
[*] small & big silver ore
[*] small & big gold ore
[/list]


[b]New buildings/stages:[/b]
[list]
[*] smelting furnace
[*] wheatfarm
[*] bakery
[*] molefarm
[*] jewelry
[*] house - stone (development stage 1)
[*] house - copper (development stage 2)
[*] house - bronze (development stage 3)
[*] house - iron (development stage 4)
[*] house - steel  (development stage 5)
[/list]

[b]Development stages:[/b]
The homes of the dwarfs will now have development stages. The higher the stage the higher the max tax income of the specific home. Next patch will have up to the steel stage. 

[b]Dwarf needs:[/b]
Dwarf needs will increase with the stage of their home. For example when their home reaches stage 2 they have to eat prezl from time to time.

[b]Merchant:[/b]
Some days a merchant will appear next to the main building where you can sell and buy limited resources.


[b]Other stuff:[/b]
Stone is destroyable 
Tiles/Blocks are dropping resources

[b]Research:[/b]
More buildings have to be researched now.

[b]Buildings:[/b]
Buildings have recipes. And now have the ability to produce different types of products. 



If you have questions please go to our Discord channel:
https://discord.gg/epfQuQ

notes.title: Patch v0.81 notes
notes.notes:
[b]Added to StoneDeep[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Depot Resources filter[/b]
you can now set a maximum count for each resource in each depot.
[*] [b]Reproduction limit[/b]
Dwarfs will now not reproduce over the maximum resident count. You know have to build houses when you want more dwarfs. It should give you more control over how fast you want to grow your population.
[*] [b]Block popup window[/b]
We added a block popup window to give you information about the blocks. we are not sure if it is helpful or just annoying. you can hide it with (i) wich is not documented yet.
[/list]


[b]Changes to the StoneDeep[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]More effektiv resource gathering from buildings[/b]
Workers will now compare the path lengths to the next depot and next building with product in it. If the way to the next building is smaller than to the next depot and his bag is not full yet he gather the resources of this building too.
[*] [b]More effektiv resource gathering from the ground[/b]
Workers will now check if there are more resources next to his own block when bag is not full.
[*] [b]Base bag size [/b]
from 20=> 50

from 200 => 300

[/list]
